ops.title: Match merge guard evidence to actual curl file transport bytes
ops.description: Owner: /root/ccx_related_topk_ship/body_streaming. Existing curl request schema combines --data and --data-binary/--json, then parses original file bytes. Official curl docs specify --data @file strips CR/LF/NUL while binary/json preserve them. A raw JSON rejection can differ from valid transmitted bypass flag, so the guard can miss intended classification. Predates body770; not a host pressure claim. Evidence: FE/capt-request-body-curl-transport-followup.json. Next: CI-only bounded loopback curl wire oracle plus exact guard regression; coordinate isolated transport-aware streaming correction with parent before changing previously missed recognition. Preserve owner/head rules and binary/raw modes.

ops.text: CI-only actual curl loopback wire capture proves original mismatch and corrected guard behavior for data versus binary/json/raw modes.
Independent security review and full normal CI preserve owner/head authority while streaming exact transmitted bytes with bounded memory.
Merged/released native and consumer changes are installed in actual Capt worker/pack with affected positive and negative verification.
